binary_kind: ELF x86_64 with Bun note; no GNU CPU minimum note found
npm_finding: Official2.1.329 package has no cli.js application. cli-wrapper.cjs/install.cjs delegate to native optional platform packages. Node would still launch the native backend.
interpretation: Reports motivate comparing the same native CLI with BUN_JSC_useJIT=0; they do not prove this is the observed crash cause.

minimum_cpu_context.current_official_bun_docs: Current x64 Bun targets Nehalem/SSE4.2 and selects AVX paths at runtime.
minimum_cpu_context.observed_guest: SSE4.2 and CX16 present; AVX absent.
minimum_cpu_context.limitation: The bundled CLI Bun revision is not yet independently identified. Lack of AVX alone does not establish an unsupported CPU or the crash cause.
